paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Llama3 under different question popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three performance metrics - accuracy, confidence, and alignment - for Llama3-8B on movies. The x-axis, labeled "Question Popularity," has a linear scale, ranging from 15 to 55, with uniform intervals of 5 between labeled points. The y-axis, labeled "Values," also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with uniform intervals of 0.2 between labeled points. 

The graph displays three distinct lines, each representing a different metric. The blue line, marked with circles, represents "Accuracy" and starts at approximately 0.55 when the question popularity is 15, increasing to around 0.94 when the question popularity reaches 55. The green line, marked with triangles, represents "Confidence" and begins at about 0.86 when the question popularity is 15, rising to nearly 0.96 when the question popularity is 55. The red line, marked with squares, represents "Alignment" and starts at roughly 0.7 when the question popularity is 15, increasing to approximately 0.95 when the question popularity is 55. All three lines exhibit an upward trend as question popularity increases, with the most significant gains observed at lower levels of question popularity.
model_annotations.German: The diagram illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three performance metrics - accuracy, confidence, and alignment - for the Llama3-8B model on movie-related questions. The x-axis represents question popularity, ranging from 15 to 55 in intervals of 5, with a linear scale and no units specified. The y-axis represents the values of the three metrics, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in intervals of 0.2, also with a linear scale. Three lines are plotted on the graph: accuracy (blue, solid line, circle markers), confidence (green, solid line, triangle markers), and alignment (red, solid line, square markers). The accuracy line starts at approximately 0.52 when question popularity is 15 and increases to around 0.94 when question popularity is 55, showing a steady upward trend. The confidence line begins at about 0.86 at a question popularity of 15 and rises to nearly 0.95 at a question popularity of 55, with a more gradual increase compared to accuracy. The alignment line starts at roughly 0.69 at a question popularity of 15 and reaches approximately 0.94 at a question popularity of 55, also exhibiting an overall increasing trend.
